text: Hi, Professor. Thanks for seeing me. No problem, what can I help you with? Could you tell me a bit more about environmental engineering? Environmental engineering is the field of engineering that deals with the protection and restoration of the environment. It’s a relatively new field that emerged in the early 20th century as a response to the growing pollution problems in cities. So, what do environmental engineers do? They work on a variety of projects aimed at protecting or restoring the environment. For example, they might design systems to clean up polluted water, or they might develop plans to reduce air pollution from factories. What kind of training do you need to be an environmental engineer? You need at least a bachelor’s degree in engineering, and it’s helpful to have experience in a related field like civil engineering or chemical engineering. Many environmental engineers also have advanced degrees like master’s or doctoral degrees. Okay, that makes sense. Thanks for taking the time to explain it to me!
